description: NaYTiP₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.87 Å. Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.26 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.20 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-37°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.60 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-38°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.61 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-40°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.51 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one P atom.
